idea-plugin.name: Rider VCX Filters Fix
idea-plugin.description:
Rider VCX Filters Fix is an offline compatibility plugin for large Unreal Engine C++ solutions opened in JetBrains Rider 2026.3.

It combines cooperating frontend and backend fixes in one package:
  • .NET backend — VCX filter enablement: neutralizes Unreal's forced VCX-filter disabling so the user's Use VCX project filters setting is honored, including turning filters off normally.
  • .NET backend — real folder presentation & operations: resolves VCX filters that correspond to real disk directories and presents them as standard project folders (without funnel icons), routes Copy/Paste, New File/Directory, Move, Rename, and Delete to the real directory instead of Intermediate\ProjectFiles, and keeps .vcxproj and .vcxproj.filters synchronized.
  • JVM frontend: restores the New Directory action on VCX folder nodes (creating both the physical folder and the matching .vcxproj.filters entry) and prevents Show All Files from inserting duplicate physical files beneath any remaining pure-virtual VCX filters.
Compatibility: JetBrains Rider 2026.3 (branch 263) and later.
Maintainer: ChenXin (L66 Tools).
Plugin ID: local.rider.vcx-filter-view-fix.

Requires a full Rider restart after installation, update, disablement, or removal.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
2.1.1
  • Present VCX filters backed by real disk directories as normal project folders (removing funnel icons and restoring standard folder behavior across UE5 and game projects).
  • Fixed Copy/Paste on files and folders so duplicated files are created in the real target directory and added to the active .vcxproj and .vcxproj.filters instead of falling into Intermediate\ProjectFiles as non-project files.
  • Restored folder Ctrl+V paste, right-click New File / New Directory (syncing empty directories into .vcxproj.filters), Explorer drag-and-drop, and folder Move/Rename/Delete compatibility.
2.0.2
Changed the compatibility declaration from the exact RD-263.7307.258 build to Rider 2026.3 and later by using since-build="263" without an until-build limit.
